title: Set up monitoring on a component
description: Attach the SNMP driver and add a reachability probe to a component, both collected by an edge node, and watch reachability and samples arrive.

steps.caption: A display mounted in Bay 2. Endpoints are how it is reached, and it has none yet, so nothing collects from it.
Add an endpoint, the way a node reaches the display.
A driver knows how to talk to a product, and what to read from it.
The SNMP driver reads standard data any SNMP agent reports, such as uptime.
You supply only its inputs. The host is the display's address.
The community is a secret's name, never its value.
The node edge-hq sits on the display's network, so it collects it.
Attach it. The driver derived the endpoint, its SNMP transport and its target.
Close it. Next, a probe for one question: can the node reach it?
A second endpoint, a bare probe this time.
An ICMP probe pings the display's address.
Create it. The probe is placed on edge-hq, aimed at that address.
Back on the display's page, a few seconds on.
Samples arrived. Vitals reads the ping's reachability and round trip, and the uptime the display reports.
